name: memory_log
description:
Appends an event to the agent session log, or reads recent log entries.
Use when: recording decisions made, actions taken, or errors encountered during a session; or when reviewing what happened in a previous session.
Scope: local append-only log (~/.config/agentic-store/memory/session.jsonl). No network access.
Not for: storing persistent facts (use memory_write), saving a full session snapshot (use memory_checkpoint).

mode.description: append (default) — add an entry. read — return recent entries.

event.description: Short event label. Required when mode=append. Example: 'file_edited', 'decision_made'.

detail.description: Optional detail string for the log entry.

data.description: Optional extra structured data to store alongside the log entry.

limit.description: Max entries to return when mode=read. Default: 20.
